column1: # CCWelikala deviations from the FM Abhaya layout (encodings/fm-abhaya.tsv in mooniak-font-tools).
# Each was checked by rendering the glyph next to its FM neighbours (2026-11-18). Same columns as the table.

column7: CCWelikala draws the repaya on _ (not in FM / Pandukabhaya), to overprint the consonant typed before it: l_ renders as ර්‍ක does in Sinhala MN. The port has no repaya role, so it is reached by a hand-written rphf rule (see git log). Visual, high confidence
CCWelikala draws ය with the repaya on © (as in කාර්‍ය); matches h_ (ය + the repaya on _). Reached by a hand-written abvs rule after rphf. Visual, high confidence
CCWelikala draws a small spacing sign like ෳ (U+0DF3) here, not Pandukabhaya's roman i. Meaning uncertain: kept typable on PUA U+E001; designer to decide
CCWelikala draws a second ග here (inner curl differs from .), not Pandukabhaya's roman v. Nothing reaches it; designer to decide
CCWelikala: the "Ceylon Calligraphy" wordmark (සිලොන් කැලිග්‍රැෆි). Kept typable on PUA U+E000; designer to decide
